dul8c0:302: In Baidu's AICR architecture, the three-level checks-and-balances design of "Review Agent → Verify Agent → Recheck Agent" is a key insight distilled from engineering practice. The Review Agent is incentivized to "find more issues" (tending to over-reason and guess defects), the Verify Agent aims to "delete nonexistent ones" (tending to over-delete and mistakenly remove real defects), and the Recheck Agent's responsibility is "don't delete real ones" (acting as the final safety net). This three-role checks-and-balances is not an accidental design choice but an engineering response to inherent biases of AI models (pre-training bias, position bias, confirmation bias) — a single Agent cannot balance both "discovery capability" and "result credibility," and multi-role collaboration cancels out different bias directions.
